user_story: As a user, I want task creation to fail when the title is empty so that all tasks have a meaningful name.

positive.title: Create a task with a non-empty title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page.
Enter a non-empty title in the title field.
positive.expected_result: Task is created successfully with the provided title.

negative.title: Attempt to create a task with an empty title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page.
negative.expected_result: Task creation fails with an error message indicating that the title is required.

edge.title: Create a task with the title at maximum allowed length
steps: Navigate to the task creation page.
Enter a title with the maximum number of characters allowed in the title field.
edge.expected_result: Task is created successfully with the full title displayed correctly.
